parts.subject: 國文
parts.title: 作文
parts.detail: 文言白話不拘，但段落要分明。

questions.stem: Despite their strong performance throughout the season, the school baseball team lost the final game ________ poor leadership by the captain.
Please refer to the ________ list to ensure you have purchased all the required textbooks for the training.
As soon as I finish the financial statement, I will submit it to the committee ________ approval.
Whenever the team faces a difficult situation, Evan can always be relied on to ________ new ideas.
The committee offered a few ________ on the report.
The new procurement system is more ________ and easier to use than the old one.
What do you think they are ________ for their next move?
My brother doesn’t care ________ life in the big city. He prefers the countryside.
All passengers are expected to ________ the instructions given by airport security personnel.
Chris ________ professionally for a number of years before he finally won his first chess championship last year.
My friend just sent me an interesting book, the title of ________ is “Mind Reader”.
The hotel staff is extremely helpful. Nothing is too ________ trouble for them.
________ the many difficulties I faced with my family, I’m glad that I took risks and chose to be different.
We want to buy a new car next year, so we’ve decided to ________ on our spending to save more money.
I would say that, ________, I spend at least five hours a day in front of a computer screen.
Albert Einstein is widely ________ as one of the greatest scientists in history for his contributions to physics.
Emma’s mother didn’t approve of ________ to Japan alone for her graduation trip.
Peter Jackson’s epic movie trilogy “The Lord of the Rings” has ________ widespread critical acclaim and numerous awards.
Most of us are flattered when we receive a sincere ________.
In a fast-changing world, why trouble yourself with problems that are ________ your control rather than focusing on what you can change?
Please buy some lunch boxes ________.

options.B: to the top of the hill
options.D: down the path by the river

questions.stem: The decommissioning project will ________ small teams working on a variety of tasks.
The project timeline is so long that it is difficult to ________ what the final cost will be.
It’s important to follow the safety procedures to avoid exposure to ________ materials.
The team made huge ________ to the new data management system.
The instruments are responsible for constantly ________ the current wind speeds.
Attending the course will ________ Vivian’s abilities and prepare her for the job.
Many insulators are made from ________ materials.
The team made deliberate efforts to give the stakeholders ________.

options.A: a struggle to find affordable childcare
options.B: a look at the famous landmarks in the city
options.C: a chance to participate in the discussion
options.D: a taste of the cute café they found while traveling

questions.stem: Each of us was given a(n) ________ and asked to complete a written story.
If we fail to ________ our claims, the supplier will not be aware of the problem.
After hours of discussion, Huang’s plan remained the ________ view among the committee members.

Some people like to joke that there is a convenience store on every street corner in Taipei City. ________ this is an exaggeration, it is true that you can shop for many things twenty-four hours a day.
His use of ________ helped to solve the problem quickly and efficiently.
The Wulai hydropower plant is famous for its ________ popsicles.
We made ________ to the practices of other companies when developing our procedures.
The judges will choose ________.

options.B: the other people that will meet them
options.C: the winner of the skills competition

questions.stem: The courageous young linemen saved ________ at the jobsite last week.

options.A: the thief from stealing the paintings
options.D: their coworker from the damaged excavator

questions.stem: We need ________ the weather accurately to maintain grid stability.
Chiang gained ________ in her specialization through years of training and experience.
